# Requires Transitive

A simple example that demonstrates the usefulness of the `requires transitive`
in conjunction with the Java Module System. The example makes used of an
in-memory database to demonstrates a realistic use case.

## Prerequisites

- [Oracle Java 25](https://www.oracle.com/java/technologies/downloads/#java25)

## Run the example

1. Build the application

   ```shell
   ./mvnw clean package
   ```

   (*Optional*) Verify that the JAR files were created and copied to the
   `./target/libs` directory.

   ```shell
   tree --sort=name './target/libs'
   ```

   The application JAR files

   ```
   ./target/libs
   ├── app.jar
   ├── db.jar
   ├── domain.jar
   ├── jackson-annotations-2.22.jar
   ├── jackson-core-2.22.2.jar
   └── jackson-databind-2.22.2.jar

   1 directory, 6 files
   ```

2. List all modules

   ```shell
   java --module-path './target/libs' --list-modules
   ```

3. Describe the JAR files

   Describe the `domain.jar`

   ```shell
   jar --describe-module --file './target/libs/domain.jar'
   ```

   The domain module description

   ```
   demo.domain@1.0.0 jar:file:///./target/libs/domain.jar!/module-info.class
   exports demo.domain
   requires java.base mandated
   ```

   Describe the `db.jar`

   ```shell
   jar --describe-module --file './target/libs/db.jar'
   ```

   The database module description

   ```
   demo.db@1.0.0 jar:file:///./target/libs/db.jar!/module-info.class
   exports demo.db
   requires com.fasterxml.jackson.databind
   requires demo.domain transitive
   requires java.base mandated
   ```

   Describe the `app.jar`

   ```shell
   jar --describe-module --file './target/libs/app.jar'
   ```

   The application module description

   ```
   demo.app@1.0.0 jar:file:///./target/libs/app.jar!/module-info.class
   requires demo.db
   requires java.base mandated
   contains demo.app
   main-class demo.app.Main
   ```

4. Run the application

   ```shell
   java \
     --module-path './target/libs' \
     --module demo.app
   ```

   The application will run and print the quotes
